subject: general
question: A train 1439 m long is running at 36 km/hr. How long will it take to clear a 1331 m long platform completely?3712
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Total Distance** = **Train Length** + **Platform Length** = 1439 + 1331 = 2770 m.

**Speed** in m/s = 36 × (5/18) = 10 m/s.

**Time Taken** = 2770 ÷ 10 = 277 sec.

**∴ The correct answer is 277 sec.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ecb0c8fbea2036aa3db574af6eebaaae890f50a19bcb27771d4c5d0d11ddad21.png] 

**Given:**

**Length of Train** (L₁) = 1439 m

**Length of Platform** (L₂) = 1331 m

**Speed of Train** (S) = 36 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Time = Total Distance ÷ Speed

To convert km/hr to m/s, multiply by 5/18.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total distance to cover = L₁ + L₂

⇒ Total distance = 1439 + 1331 = 2770 m

⇒ Speed in m/s = 36 × (5/18) = 2 × 5 = 10 m/s

⇒ Time = 2770 ÷ 10

⇒ Time = 277 sec

**∴ The correct answer is 277 sec.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Unit Conversion

To convert km/hr to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.

Relative Speed

When two objects move in the **opposite direction**, relative speed is the **sum** of their speeds (S₁ + S₂). In the **same direction**, it is the **difference** (S₁ − S₂).

Crossing Stationary Objects

When a train crosses a **pole or a man**, distance = length of train. When it crosses a **bridge or platform**, distance = train length + platform length.</p
